title: dLoop: Looped Diffusion Language Models via Recurrent Latent Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2611.26275v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) support parallel generation, yet they often require many denoising steps because only a fraction of token predictions are sufficiently reliable to be committed at each step. Existing acceleration methods primarily optimize confidence learning or commitment policies. However, these approaches operate on the outputs of a single denoising forward pass, in which information from the prompt, previously committed tokens, and uncommitted positions may not yet be fully integrated. Consequently, some predictions remain under-refined when the commitment decision is made, and modifying the commitment policy alone cannot improve their underlying representations. We introduce dLoop, which restructures a pretrained diffusion language model into a Prelude-Loop-Coda architecture and recurrently applies a parameter-shared intermediate block to the same partially masked state. translated_title: dLoop：通过循环潜在精炼实现的循环扩散语言模型
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）支持并行生成，但由于每一步中只有一小部分token预测足够可靠从而能被提交，它们通常需要许多去噪步骤。现有的加速方法主要优化置信度学习或提交策略。然而，这些方法作用于单次去噪前向传播的输出，而在这个输出中，来自提示词、已提交token和未提交位置的信息可能尚未被充分整合。因此，在做出提交决策时，一些预测仍未得到充分精炼，而仅仅修改提交策略无法改善其底层表示。我们提出了dLoop，它将预训练的扩散语言模型重构为Prelude-Loop-Coda（前奏-循环-尾声）架构，并将参数共享的中间块循环地应用于相同的部分掩码状态，而不是推进去噪过程（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: dLoop通过将预训练扩散语言模型重构为Prelude-Loop-Coda架构，并对相同的部分掩码状态循环应用参数共享的中间块来迭代精炼潜在表示，从而在不推进去噪过程的情况下提升预测的可靠性，减少所需去噪步骤并加速生成。
en_tdlr: dLoop restructures a pretrained diffusion language model into a Prelude-Loop-Coda architecture that recurrently applies a parameter-shared intermediate block to the same partially masked state, refining latent representations beyond a single denoising pass to improve prediction reliability and reduce the number of denoising steps.
